ValidationRule.description: If Approved Temporarily = true then the agent has to fill in Approved Temporary Limit and Credit Fraud Team Result
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Credit Limit Increase Application"), ISPICKVAL(cc_Request_Type__c, "permanent"), cc_Approved_Temporarily__c == true, OR( ISBLANK(cc_Approved_Temporary_Limit__c), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_Results__c, "") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill in the Approved Temporary Limit, and Credit Fraud Team Result manually.
